overview: Zoho CRM uses OAuth 2.0. You register an OAuth application in the Zoho API Console, receive a Client ID and Client Secret, then redirect users through Zoho's authorisation flow. Zoho issues a scoped access token on completion.

oauth_client_id.label: Client ID
oauth_client_id.description: Found in the Zoho API Console after creating a Server-based Application. Listed under your app's credentials.

oauth_client_secret.label: Client Secret
oauth_client_secret.description: Found alongside the Client ID in the API Console. Keep it confidential.

steps.title: Open the Zoho API Console
steps.description: Go to api-console.zoho.com and sign in with your Zoho account.

steps.title: Create a Server-based Application
steps.description: Click 'Add Client'. Select 'Server-based Applications'. Enter an application name, homepage URL, and the Nolixan callback URL as the Authorized Redirect URI.
steps.tip: Choose 'Server-based Applications' (not 'Self Client') for standard OAuth flows with user authorisation.

steps.title: Set the redirect URI
steps.description: Add the Nolixan callback URL as an Authorized Redirect URI.
steps.warning: The redirect URI must match exactly. A mismatch causes 'invalid_redirect_uri' errors.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.description: After creating the app, Zoho displays the Client ID and Client Secret. Copy both and store them securely.
steps.warning: Never expose the Client Secret in client-side code or public repositories.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: In Nolixan, create an integration with the Client ID, Client Secret, and required scopes. Then initiate the OAuth flow.

tips: Access tokens expire after 1 hour — Nolixan auto-refreshes them using the refresh token.
Zoho CRM has region-specific API endpoints (com, eu, in, com.au). The base URL https://www.zohoapis.com auto-routes to the correct region.
Use ZohoCRM.modules.ALL for broad access, or specify individual module scopes for tighter control.
warnings: If a user revokes access, they must re-authorise via the OAuth flow.
Zoho rate limits API calls per day — monitor usage to avoid hitting the daily limit.
